title: Thermaltake Smart BM3 750W 80 Plus Bronze Power Supply

comparisons.notes: Sold and shipped by Newegg; part number PS-SPD-0750MNFABU-3, model SPD-750AH2CLB, 750W exact match.
MPN PS-SPD-0750MNFABU-3, model SPD-750AH2CLB; 10 in stock, free shipping.

writeup: The Thermaltake Smart BM3 is a 750W 80 Plus Bronze semi-modular power supply (model SPD-750AH2CLB) with ATX 3.1 support and a native 16-pin GPU cable. Woot has it for $32.90, while Newegg sells the same unit for $81.99 and Neutron USA for $103.05. Woot showed only 2 left at this price, with a limit of 10 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Woot listing ASIN B0CFXGFQNZ matches Thermaltake Smart BM3 750W, MPN PS-SPD-0750MNFABU-3, per upstream verified check.
